related.title: in-toto：建置步驟材料與產物鏈
related.titleEn: in-toto: materials and products across build steps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12包條件矩陣、精確身分政策、錯誤發行者測試及驗證器版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a twelve-bundle matrix, precise identity policy, wrong-issuer tests and verifier version.
related.difference: 逐步記錄材料摘要、產物摘要與執行者，檢查前一步產物是否等於下一步材料。
related.differenceEn: Record materials, products and functionary for every step; check that upstream products equal downstream materials.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 政策接受是交集；不能把「某人簽過」等同「預期發布流程簽過」。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個合成驗證包中10個密碼學有效；其中8個符合身分，7個也符合發行者與摘要。 通過率7/12=58.3333%，密碼學有效率10/12=83.3333%，兩者不同。
鏈結完整率=有完整摘要交接的邊/必要交接邊；每步存在紀錄仍可能在交接處斷鏈。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 四步流程有3條必要交接，只有2條摘要相符；封裝引用了另一版本測試產物。 完整率2/3=66.6667%；即使四步都標成功仍不能發布。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Policy acceptance is an intersection; someone signed is not equivalent to the intended release workflow signed. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of twelve synthetic bundles, ten are cryptographically valid; eight match identity and seven also match issuer and digest. Policy pass rate is 58.3333%, distinct from cryptographic validity of 83.3333%.

Handoff completeness is evidenced edges divided by required edges; individual step records do not guarantee connected handoffs. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Four steps require three handoffs; only two match because packaging references a different tested product. Completeness is 2/3=66.6667%; four successful step labels still cannot justify release.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy：選擇器聯集與雙向允許
related.titleEn: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy: selector unions and two-sided permission
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12包條件矩陣、精確身分政策、錯誤發行者測試及驗證器版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a twelve-bundle matrix, precise identity policy, wrong-issuer tests and verifier version.
related.difference: 對隔離中的來源與目的同時檢查egress及ingress，分清同一規則內的交集與多規則聯集。
related.differenceEn: For isolated source and destination, check both egress and ingress; distinguish conjunctions within a rule from unions across rules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 政策接受是交集；不能把「某人簽過」等同「預期發布流程簽過」。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個合成驗證包中10個密碼學有效；其中8個符合身分，7個也符合發行者與摘要。 通過率7/12=58.3333%，密碼學有效率10/12=83.3333%，兩者不同。
在本案例兩端均隔離時，可通=來源egress允許且目的ingress允許；政策支援依賴網路實作。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個候選有向連線中egress允許8個、ingress允許7個，兩者同時允許5個。 政策允許5/12=41.6667%，不是8+7條；只有在其他網路條件正常且政策實際生效時才可推論可通。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Policy acceptance is an intersection; someone signed is not equivalent to the intended release workflow signed. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of twelve synthetic bundles, ten are cryptographically valid; eight match identity and seven also match issuer and digest. Policy pass rate is 58.3333%, distinct from cryptographic validity of 83.3333%.

With both endpoints isolated, connectivity requires source egress AND destination ingress permission; enforcement depends on network implementation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of twelve directed candidate connections, egress allows eight and ingress seven; five are allowed by both. Policy permits 5/12=41.6667%, not eight plus seven connections; actual connectivity additionally assumes a working network and enforced policy.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
